_description: Authoritative cross-verified metadata and structural/electronic parameters for monolayer and bulk CrCl3 extracted from papers/.

discrepancy_audit_summary.issue: Inconsistent lattice parameters (a = 5.96 A for Webster, a = 6.00 A for Luo) and band gaps cited in plotting scripts.

root_cause_analysis.webster_2018: Table I of Webster 2018 explicitly reports a0 = 6.056 A (NOT 5.96 A). The 5.96 A value was an accidental transcription error from experimental bulk/MBE papers.
root_cause_analysis.luo_2020: Section 2 (page 2, line 115) of Luo 2020 explicitly reports 'a = b = 6.056 A' citing Webster [21] (NOT 6.00 A). The Cr-Cl bond length is 2.352 A.
root_cause_analysis.gao_2018: Table 1 of Gao 2018 explicitly reports monolayer DFT-GGA relaxed a = b = 5.985 A, Cr-Cl bond length 2.355 A, and layer thickness c = 2.439 A.
root_cause_analysis.bedoya_pinto_2021: Experimental MBE monolayer on graphene reports in-plane lattice parameter a = 5.96 +/- 0.05 A from RHEED/STM.
root_cause_analysis.dillon_1966: Bulk experimental crystal structure reports a = 5.959 A (monoclinic C2/m at 300 K) and a = 5.942 A, c = 17.333 A (rhombohedral R-3 hexagonal setting at low temperature).
root_cause_analysis.pollini_1970: Bulk intrinsic optical absorption measures fundamental charge-transfer threshold at 3.2 +/- 0.1 eV with sub-gap d-d crystal-field peaks at 1.68 eV and 2.28 eV.

discrepancy_audit_summary.resolution: Updated all benchmark markers in plot_lattice_vs_u.py and plot_bandgap_vs_u_benchmarks.py with exact verified literature values.
